messages:
sophia: Heads-up — I flipped fp8 kernel on a small slice of traffic for atlas-13b on H100 + L40S routing yesterday. short smoke looked fine but our quality evals show a subtle token-level floor shift on conversational prompts.
ryan: ugh. what metric/amount?
sophia: on our internal QA set median token-prob delta ~ -0.03 logp, avg perplexity +4%. Not huge but consistent across seeds. top-k/typical sampling behaviour slightly more conservative.
ananya: any pattern by prefix length or kv reuse? warmup?
sophia: looks correlated with KV-warmup hits. warm sessions (long prefix reuse) show smaller delta. cold starts (first 32 tokens after model load) show the largest shift.
jules: could be stash/kv packing differences between fp32 path and fp8 kernel. did you run with the exact same kv-tiling/config?
sophia: yes config pinned. We did: `--enable-fp8-kernel --kv-mode=stash --tiling=auto` on canary nodes. Canary logs: `kv_warmup_hits=0.12 cold_start_ratio=0.48`.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment 1765554321 started on h100-pool-4, 20% traffic.
ryan: can you paste a small failing example? sample tokens + probs?
sophia: pasted below (simplified):
```
Prompt: "What's the weather like in Paris tomorrow?"
FP32: token_probs=[-1.2, -0.8, -0.5, -0.3] -> response: "Mostly sunny with ..."
FP8kernel: token_probs=[-1.3, -0.85, -0.55, -0.35] -> response: "Mostly sunny with..." (same text but lower avg prob)
```
ryan: hmm same decode but lower confidence. Could downstream eval thresholding treat lower logits differently (e.g., picking shorter completions)?
ananya: Also saw a couple of cases where sampling produced alternate tokens early in generation when top-p near 0.9. Might be a tiny softmax temperature shift from quant noise.
jules: run a micro-batch where we capture pre-softmax logits + kv norms for first 64 steps across fp32 vs fp8 kernels. add `--dump-kv-norms` and `--capture-logits` flags.
sophia: already on it. collecting traces now and pushing to s3: s3://redwood-canaries/fp8-kv-warmup/1765554321/trace.tar.gz
canary-bot: Trace upload complete (1765554321) — 42MB.
ryan: also try toggling `--kv-warmup-steps=0` on fp8 to see if warmup codepath is masking something. If delta disappears, bug in warmup/scale heuristic.
ananya: good call. I'll spin a small job with warmup disabled and run eval harness.
sophia: quick interim: disabling fp8 stash path for cold-start routes reduced the median logp delta to ~ -0.005, essentially noise. So plausible narrow hotpath.
jules: could be activation scaling with per-layer adaptive scale vs global scale mismatch. fp8 kernels expect certain calibration during warmup. if stash bypasses calibration we might be using stale scales.
ryan: let's add a canary that runs fp8+explicit recalibrate step: `--fp8-recalibrate --recalib-samples=2000` and compare.
ananya: running both variants now: fp8-stash-default, fp8-stash-no-warmup, fp8-stash-recalib. will post numbers in ~90m.
sophia: timeline & next steps: 1) block broader rollout until we have the recalib canary results, 2) add per-layer kv-norm telemetry to console dashboards, 3) put a short runbook note: if cold-token floor > 0.02 rollback.
jules: also file a kernel bug with the fp8 runtime folks — include traces and a couple of short reproducer scripts (we should add `tests/reproducers/fp8_kv_warmup_repro.py`).
sophia: created issue IR-3124 and attached traces + reproducer. tagging @jules @ryan.
ryan: thanks. appreciate the quick triage. if recalib fixes it we should add an enablement checklist for new models: "run fp8-recalib on small validation slice + kv-warmup smoke" before enabling.
ananya: agree — I'll draft a tiny checklist and a Grafana panel for kv-warmup hit ratio + per-layer scale variance.
sophia: OK will hold the rollout. will update when canary finishes. :thumbsup:
